request.text: I carry my laptop to class. Can you find me a new 14-inch laptop with at least 16 GB RAM and a 1 TB SSD, around $1,000 delivered to Beirut?

message:
Best value: Technodel’s Acer Swift Go 14 — $720.00, with free delivery to Beirut under its over-$500 policy. Listed in stock and confirmed new, with 16GB RAM and a 1TB SSD.
For touchscreen notes: Technodel’s Lenovo IdeaPad 5 14AKP10 — $975.00 with free delivery; confirmed new and in stock, with 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD and a 14-inch convertible touchscreen.
Second-shop comparison: Karizma’s IdeaPad 5 2-in-1 14 — $999.00 with free delivery over $150. Listed in stock, but new condition is not explicitly confirmed.
I’d start with the Acer for value. Since you carry it to class, check the exact model’s weight and battery specification before ordering; those details weren’t confirmed in the listings.
